column1: # Deskripsi SKILL — putaran kelima puluh lima ekor panjang.

#   "<color=#f26c1c>30%</color><color=#3487e0>{0}</color>"  (dua tag berdempet)
#   "this skill’s cooldown"                                 (apostrof melengkung)
# --- pendek ---
=At the start of battle, gain <color=#f26c1c>3 stacks</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Di awal pertempuran, mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>3 stack</color> <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column2: Jika musuhnya terbunuh, mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>2 poin</color> Confectance Index.

column1: =Vector gains <color=#f26c1c>2</color> more points of Confectance Index.
column2: Vector mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>2</color> poin Confectance Index lagi.

column1: =At the end of the action, Lind gains Confectance Index.
column2: Di akhir aksi, Lind mendapatkan Confectance Index.

column1: =All enemy units' defense is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.
column2: Defense semua unit musuh berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.

column1: =All enemy units' defense is reduced.
column2: Defense semua unit musuh berkurang.

column2: Unit ini masuk ke <color=#3487e0>Surveillance</color>.

column2: Pilih semua target musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 6 tile</color>.

column2: Skill ini tidak bisa diaktifkan tanpa <color=#3487e0>Magazine</color>.

column2: Area terdampak dan damage multiplier-nya tergantung jumlah <color=#3487e0>Magazine</color>:

column2: <color=#f26c1c>2</color> <color=#3487e0>Magazine</color>: Area terdampak: <color=#f26c1c>3×5</color>.

column1: =<color=#f26c1c>3</color> <color=#3487e0>Magazines</color>: Affected area: <color=#f26c1c>5×5</color>.
column2: <color=#f26c1c>3</color> <color=#3487e0>Magazine</color>: Area terdampak: <color=#f26c1c>5×5</color>.

column1: =Damage multiplier: <color=#f26c1c>80%</color> of attack.
column2: Damage multiplier: <color=#f26c1c>80%</color> Attack.

column1: =Damage multiplier: <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> of attack.
column2: Damage multiplier: <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> Attack.

column2: Damage multiplier: <color=#f26c1c>120%</color> Attack.

column2: Memakan satu unit yang memiliki <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> sampai awal giliran berikutnya.

column1: # --- serangan ---
=Selects 1 direction and moves in that direction, dealing melee <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> to the first enemy encountered.
column2: Memilih 1 arah lalu bergerak ke arah itu, memberikan melee <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> ke musuh pertama yang ditemui.

column1: =Selects 1 direction and uses all <color=#3487e0>Magazines</color>, dealing AoE Physical damage to all targets within a specific range based on the number of <color=#3487e0>Magazines</color> used.
column2: Memilih 1 arah lalu memakai seluruh <color=#3487e0>Magazine</color>, memberikan AoE Physical damage ke semua target dalam jangkauan tertentu berdasarkan jumlah <color=#3487e0>Magazine</color> yang dipakai.

column1: =Selects 1 tile within <color=#f26c1c>8 tiles</color> to launch an attack, dealing AoE physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>85%</color> of attack to all enemy targets within <color=#f26c1c>2 tiles</color>.
column2: Memilih 1 tile <color=#f26c1c>dalam 8 tile</color> untuk diserang, memberikan AoE physical damage setara <color=#f26c1c>85%</color> Attack ke semua target musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 2 tile</color>.

column1: =At the start of next turn, pulls all marked enemies towards the user and deals AoE physical damage.
column2: Di awal giliran berikutnya, menarik semua musuh yang ditandai ke arah pengguna lalu memberikan AoE physical damage.

column1: =After the second attack, deals an additional instance of fixed damage to the nearest enemy unit within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color> of the secondary target.
column2: Setelah serangan kedua, memberikan tambahan satu kali fixed damage ke unit musuh terdekat <color=#f26c1c>dalam 3 tile</color> dari target keduanya.

column1: =If an enemy within <color=#f26c1c>6 tiles</color> deals targeted damage to an allied unit, launches a <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> at the attacker.
column2: Jika musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 6 tile</color> memberikan targeted damage ke unit sekutu, melancarkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> ke penyerangnya.

column1: =Passive: Before enemy units <color=#f26c1c>within 8 tiles</color> make an active attack, perform <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> on them, dealing <color=#42cce0>Freeze damage</color> and stability damage.
column2: Passive: Sebelum unit musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 8 tile</color> melancarkan serangan aktif, melancarkan <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> kepada mereka, memberikan <color=#42cce0>Freeze damage</color> dan Stability damage.

column1: =At the end of an ally Doll's action, Welrod deals 1 instance of AoE <color=#8679e8>Corrosion Damage</color> to all enemy targets <color=#f26c1c>within 6 tiles</color> equal to <color=#f26c1c>30%</color><color=#3487e0>{0}</color> of accumulated damage and applies <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.
column2: Di akhir aksi Doll sekutu, Welrod memberikan 1 kali AoE <color=#8679e8>Corrosion Damage</color> ke semua target musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 6 tile</color> setara <color=#f26c1c>30%</color><color=#3487e0>{0}</color> damage yang terkumpul lalu menerapkan <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> selama <color=#f26c1c>2 giliran</color>.

column1: =At the end of the action, applies <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> to the enemy with the highest attack within <color=#f26c1c>7 tiles</color>.
column2: Di akhir aksi, menerapkan <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> ke musuh dengan serangan tertinggi <color=#f26c1c>dalam 7 tile</color>.

column1: # --- pemicu & syarat ---
=If this attack hits enemy targets on phase tiles, deal additional <color=#42cce0>Freeze damage</color> to them.
column2: Jika serangan ini mengenai target musuh di atas tile fase, memberikan tambahan <color=#42cce0>Freeze damage</color> kepada mereka.

column1: =If this attack hits enemy targets on phase tiles, deal <color=#f26c1c>an additional</color> instance of <color=#42cce0>Freeze damage</color> to them equal to <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> of attack.
column2: Jika serangan ini mengenai target musuh di atas tile fase, memberikan <color=#f26c1c>tambahan</color> satu kali <color=#42cce0>Freeze damage</color> kepada mereka setara <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> Attack.

column1: =If the target is killed, deals fixed damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>30%</color> of attack to all enemies within <color=#f26c1c>2 tiles</color> of the target and generates <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> tiles for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.
column2: Jika targetnya terbunuh, memberikan fixed damage setara <color=#f26c1c>30%</color> Attack ke semua musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 2 tile</color> dari target lalu menghasilkan tile <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> selama <color=#f26c1c>2 giliran</color>.

column1: =If the enemy is killed, this skill’s cooldown is decreased by <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.
column2: Jika musuhnya terbunuh, cooldown skill ini berkurang sebanyak <color=#f26c1c>2 giliran</color>.

column1: =If any enemy targets are killed, reduces the cooldown of the Ultimate skill <color=#3487e0>Devastating Drift</color> by <color=#f26c1c>1 turn</color> and gains <color=#f26c1c>2 points</color> of Confectance Index.
column2: Jika ada target musuh yang terbunuh, mengurangi cooldown skill Ultimate <color=#3487e0>Devastating Drift</color> <color=#f26c1c>1 giliran</color> lalu mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>2 poin</color> Confectance Index.

column1: =If no enemy targets are killed, applies <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> to the target for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.
column2: Jika tidak ada target musuh yang terbunuh, menerapkan <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> ke target selama <color=#f26c1c>2 giliran</color>.

column1: =If the attack exploits the target's any weakness, gains an additional <color=#f26c1c>2 points</color> of Confectance Index and reduces the cooldown of this skill by <color=#f26c1c>1 turn</color>.
column2: Jika serangannya mengeksploitasi kelemahan target, mendapatkan tambahan <color=#f26c1c>2 poin</color> Confectance Index lalu mengurangi cooldown skill ini sebesar <color=#f26c1c>1 giliran</color>.

column1: =If the target has an Electric debuff, increases damage dealt by <color=#f26c1c>10%</color> and gains <color=#f26c1c>2 points</color> of Confectance Index.
column2: Jika target memiliki debuff Electric, damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>10%</color> dan mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>2 poin</color> Confectance Index.

column1: =If the target has a defense debuff, change the damage dealt to AoE physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>95%</color> of attack and <color=#f26c1c>4 points</color> of stability damage.
column2: Jika target memiliki debuff Defense, mengubah damage yang diberikan jadi AoE physical damage setara <color=#f26c1c>95%</color> Attack dan <color=#f26c1c>4 poin</color> Stability damage.

column1: =If the target has <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, increase it by an additional <color=#f26c1c>2.5%</color>.
column2: Jika target memiliki <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, nilainya naik lagi <color=#f26c1c>2.5%</color>.

column1: =If the target is inflicted with <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, ignores their Cover damage reduction and gains <color=#f26c1c>5 tiles</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Jika target terkena <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, mengabaikan pengurangan damage Cover mereka lalu mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> sebanyak <color=#f26c1c>5 tile</color>.

column1: =If the target is inflicted with <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, ignores their Cover damage reduction and gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Jika target terkena <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, mengabaikan pengurangan damage Cover mereka lalu mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =If the target is inflicted with <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, ignores their Cover damage reduction, increases critical rate by <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> for this attack, and gains <color=#f26c1c>5 tiles</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Jika target terkena <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, mengabaikan pengurangan damage Cover mereka, menambah Critical Rate sebesar <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> untuk serangan ini, lalu mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> sebanyak <color=#f26c1c>5 tile</color>.

column1: =If this unit does not have <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> or <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>, no buffs will be cleansed.
column2: Jika unit ini tidak memiliki <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> atau <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>, tidak ada buff yang dibersihkan.

column1: =When an enemy unit with <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> dies or an allied unit deals <color=#8679e8>Corrosion damage</color>, Lind gains <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.
column2: Saat unit musuh yang memiliki <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> mati atau unit sekutu memberikan <color=#8679e8>Corrosion damage</color>, Lind mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.

column1: =When Groza is under the effects of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, damage dealt is increased.
column2: Saat Groza terkena efek <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, damage yang diberikan meningkat.

column1: =When under the effects of <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> or <color=#3487e0>Blazing Assault</color>, stability damage is increased by <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> respectively.
column2: Saat terkena efek <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> atau <color=#3487e0>Blazing Assault</color>, Stability damage masing-masing bertambah sebesar <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color>.

column1: =At the end of the action, grants <color=#f26c1c>1</color> point of Confectance Index for <color=#f26c1c>each</color> Burn buff.
column2: Di akhir aksi, memberikan <color=#f26c1c>1</color> poin Confectance Index untuk <color=#f26c1c>setiap</color> buff Burn.

column1: =At the end of the action, gains Confectance Index based on the number of Burn buffs.
column2: Di akhir aksi, mendapatkan Confectance Index berdasarkan jumlah buff Burn.

column1: =The base damage multiplier is increased by <color=#f26c1c>5%</color> for <color=#f26c1c>each additional point</color> of Confectance Index expended.
column2: Damage multiplier dasarnya meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>5%</color> untuk <color=#f26c1c>setiap poin tambahan</color> Confectance Index yang dipakai.

column1: =For each instance of damage taken (includes damage inflicted by <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>), her attack is increased by <color=#f26c1c>1%</color>, to a maximum increase of <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.

column1: =Does not benefit from cover, critical rate is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>100%</color>, Max HP is increased by <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> and damage taken is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.
column2: Tidak mendapatkan keuntungan dari Cover, Critical Rate berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>100%</color>, Max HP bertambah sebesar <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> dan damage yang diterima berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.

column1: =If an allied unit ends its action within <color=#f26c1c>5 tiles</color> of this unit, they recover HP equal to <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> of defense and <color=#f26c1c>2 points</color> of stability, and gain <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.
